Can I get an alert before a shipment arrives?

Yes. Turn on alerts and choose email, WhatsApp or both. We message you 3 days before your ETA, on the day, and 2 days after it passes. You can also tap Remind me on any shipment to add a reminder to your phone calendar, which works offline. Alerts follow the ETA you enter, not live carrier status.
Can I share a shipment with my customer?
Yes. Each card has a WhatsApp button that sends the number, carrier, ETA and your note. There is also a button to share your whole active list.
